name: 24″ Bathroom TV – Mirrored
description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the sleek, space-saving 24″ Mirrored Bathroom TV from ProofVision. When switched off, it functions as a stylish mirror, seamlessly blending into your décor. Designed for in-wall installation, it features a built-in Freeview tuner with access to over 60 digital channels and a heated screen to prevent misting.

With an IP65 waterproof rating, it’s built for steamy bathroom environments, letting you enjoy entertainment without worry. Backed by a two-year warranty, this TV combines modern convenience, functionality and elegant design which is perfect for any contemporary bathroom.

Key features

  • 24inch Display
  • In-wall installation
  • Mirror TV functionality & finish
  • Built In Digital Freeview tuner, picking up over 60 TV channels
  • Heated screen to prevent misting
  • Two year warranty

name: Grohe Dual Flush Concealed Cistern
description:
A concealed flushing cistern suitable for walls 18 – 24mm thick with actuation from front, top, left or right. The cistern features a 6/3 litre dual flush and an EcoButton to reduce your water consumption by up to 50%. Comes supplied with bottom inlet and round push button.

Key features

  • Dual Flush

  • Mechanical round push button actuation Ø 50 mm with Eco button

name: Frontline concealed cistern with side inlet
description:
The key to a stylish bathroom is in the planning. With Easi-plan any bathroom structure is possible and space can be used much more efficiently. Easi-plan offers an ultra-flexible range of concealed sanitaryware installation frames that allow the bathroom designer to design with flair and imagination with no need to compromise the installation quality.

These hidden frames cover all aspects of sanitaryware and brassware installation including WC’s basins and bidets. They create a pre-wall fixing system that eliminates the need for unsightly pipe-boxing and exposed pipes.

Voids created by the Easi-plan frame system also offer the option of having stylish recessed natural timber cabinets to make maximum use of space within the bathroom. They offer vital storage space, an area often overlooked in bathrooms, whilst giving the room the ultimate designer look.

Key features

  • Frames are supplied complete with extension bolt set and quick fix nuts
  • Easy install wall brackets for vertical or horizontal fixing
  • The wall bracket and top of frame are designed for easy shelf installation
  • 0-280mm height adjustable feet with sound deadening pads

Suitable for single or series installation, the pack includes a wall plate with dual flush actuation, and a self-supporting powder-coated steel frame is also part of the set.

Suitable to use with rimless and wall hung toilets. Just right for modern settings, it offers an attractive package of beauty and utility. An excellent value-adding acquisition, it can be used in most bathroom decors.

Key features

  • Water supply from left, right or back
  • Insulated against condensation
  • Skate cosmopolitan wall plate
  • Wall plate features: Dual flush actuation

name: Alto Wall Mounted Basin Mixer – Chrome
description:

It has a ‘mixer’ design that mixes your hot and cold water supply into a single spout, saving you the hassle of messing around with separate taps. Perfect for cloakrooms, en-suites or family bathrooms, the single lever handle ensures this tap is practical and easy to use, whilst the cascading water flow will instil contemporary luxury into your bathroom. Key features

  • Ceramic disc cartridge reduces leaks and drips
  • Modern, polished chrome finish
  • Hard-wearing, solid brass construction
  • Suitable for high-pressure systems between 1-2 bar
